wiki.title: David Clark (Georgia politician)
wiki.extract: David Timothy Clark (born July 15, 1986) is an American politician. He is a member of the Georgia House of Representatives from the 100th District, serving since 2015. Clark has sponsored 159 bills. He is a member of the Republican Party. In June 2022, Clark gained attention after beating the Majority Caucus Chairwoman, Bonnie Rich, with 59.25% of the vote.
